blurb.zh-Hans: 1920 年的波士顿，房东雇你查清一栋没人住得下去的老宅：前任租客发了疯，邻居管它叫鬼屋，地窖底下埋着一个不该被埋在那里的人。无需模组 PDF，建好调查员即可开场。
blurb.en: Boston, 1920. A landlord hires you to find out what is wrong with the house nobody will keep: the last tenants went mad, the neighbours call it haunted, and someone who should never have been buried lies under the basement. Playable without the scenario PDF.
